t: Milwaukee Premium Magnetic 8m tape measure 2-pack provides accurate and durable measurement for various trade applications. Each tape measure features a compact and ergonomic design, ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders requiring reliable measuring tools on site. A 5-point reinforced frame ensures maximum jobsite durability, complemented by a straight, stiff blade for precise measurements over long distances. The strong magnetic hook offers excellent holding power on flat surfaces and round pipes. Blade durability is enhanced by a double-sided, anti-tear coating on the first 15cm, alongside improved retraction speed and double-sided printing for clear readability. An architect scale assists with scaled drawing calculations.
